title: Request related to G5 native calibration.
body: when native G5 calibration is selected, I believe it would be useful to have a warning show on the main screen that the sensor is about to expire.  Say starting 6 hours before that occurs.  Currently when 7 days passes xDrip simply errors until you restart or the auto-restart may kick in at an inappropriate time.

comments.body:
@PedanticAvenger Would you please close this issue?
You can place a note on the main screen showing when the sensor will expire.
If you need to know how, please respond.
If that is not sufficient, please explain.
Thanks

Issue was addressed, forgot i had this issue opened.
Closure fine.
